surface: daily terminations export (SFTP flat-file drop, one CSV per day)
auth_scope: read-only SFTP service account restricted to the exports/terminations/ drop directory (no HRIS UI access, no write access)

pagination.exhaustion_method: single daily file carries the full period-to-date termination set; compare row count against the trailer record's declared total before accepting the file

rate_limits: batch cadence: one export generated per day; no interactive rate limit applies
history_caveats: Daily snapshot cadence: the feed proves what the HRIS reported as of each export, not intra-day event timing
Contractors managed outside the HRIS never appear in this feed - population completeness needs a corroborating source

provenance.doc_version: fixture-generic HRIS feed; engagement feed is a daily SFTP CSV export (representative vendor docs cited)
